mentalQuestion: Have you felt mentally overloaded or unable to switch off?

question2.question: Have you felt tense, anxious, or under constant pressure?

question3.question: Have you had difficulty concentrating on tasks?

question4.question: Have you found yourself worrying or thinking about work even when not working?

question5.question: Have you felt mentally tired even after rest?

question6.question: Have you felt calm and in control of your day-to-day demands?

question7.question: Have you had difficulty falling or staying asleep due to stress?

question8.question: Have you felt easily irritated or overwhelmed by small issues?
